standard.summary: 将整个 Anima DiT 编译为单图（非逐块）
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Compiles the whole Anima DiT as one graph rather than block by block.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 将整个 Anima DiT backbone 编译为单个图（而非 per-block 逐块编译）。后端会先运行 适合长训练且模型前向稳定的场景。

advanced_en.principle: Compiles the entire Anima DiT backbone into a single graph (rather than per-block compilation). The backend first runs it — suited to long training runs and models with a stable forward pass.
